# esptool-js 0.7.0

Unmodified browser ESM bundle from the published Espressif npm package:

- Upstream: https://github.com/espressif/esptool-js
- Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/esptool-js/-/esptool-js-0.7.0.tgz
- npm integrity (verified before extraction): `sha512-9wHuW/s9t4Vs6HKcr3pra3gbRVWwaN0eabMWodWH4KEJHEYZxgmWwZ3s0F4xcWVCZOc/L98bGZ4uWoZvR8KBKA==`

- License: Apache-2.0; see `LICENSE` from upstream tag `v0.7.0`.
- Copyright 2019 Espressif Systems (Shanghai) CO LTD.

The published bundle incorporates dependency code. The declared dependencies are
pako (`^2.1.0`) and atob-lite (`^2.0.0`); their license notices are provided in
`PAKO-LICENSE` and `ATOB-LICENSE`, taken from npm packages pako 2.1.0 and
atob-lite 2.0.0. This is an integrity-pinned upstream artifact, not a claim of a
locally reproduced upstream build.

No CDN, package install, telemetry, or library download occurs in an operator's
browser. Humus imports this file only after an explicit USB operation. No
firmware binaries or credentials are bundled here.
